hooks.prompt: Review the assistant's work in this conversation. If any .ts/.tsx/.css/.html files were created or modified, check whether a verification command (yarn build, yarn typecheck, yarn lint, or yarn test) was actually run AFTER the last edit and its real output shown. If files were changed but no verification was run, respond with {"decision": "block", "reason": "Run the gate (yarn lint && yarn build, plus yarn typecheck/yarn test once they exist) and paste the real output before declaring work complete."}. If the assistant claimed a stage passed without running it, block for the same reason. Otherwise respond with {"decision": "allow"}.
